problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize F(x)=max_i E[loss(x,Z_i)] over a nonempty compact convex domain in R^d. Each sample loss is convex, G-Lipschitz, and valued in [0,1].

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: A query selects a group i and returns one fresh sample Z_i. The loss function is public, so samples can be reused for loss evaluations. Samples are independent across groups and across reservoir rows. Cost counts individual sample replies, not gradient or loss evaluations.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Euclidean space R^d; the domain lies within radius R of its public feasible point x0, with R≥0.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Hidden gap bounds g_i∈[0,1] satisfy g_i≤F(x*)−risk_i(x*) simultaneously at some minimizer x*. They need not hold away from that minimizer. The sample budget depends on sum_i max(g_i,ε)^(-2). The algorithm receives the public domain, loss, d, K, x0, R, G, ε and δ, but not the gaps or distributions. K≥1, G≥0; no differentiability or smoothness is assumed.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The underlying convex group DRO formulation and sampling oracle are standard, but the instance-sensitive setup uses hidden group-risk gaps at a single common optimizer, without requiring uniform separation throughout the domain.

descriptionHtml:
Group DRO with Optimum Gaps

We minimize the worst-group risk F(x)=max1≤i≤KEZ∼νi[ℓ(x,Z)] over a compact convex set X⊆Rd, where K≥1 is the number of groups, νi is group i’s sample law, and ℓ is a jointly measurable, bounded, convex, Lipschitz loss on X. Hidden lower bounds describe group-risk gaps at a common minimizer. The oracle returns a fresh sample from a queried group, with independent sample streams across groups. For accuracy ε>0 and failure probability δ>0, the goal is a measurable output x¯ always in X with F(x¯)−minx∈XF(x)≤ε with probability at least 1−δ.

Let d≥0 be an integer, let Z be a measurable sample space, and let ℓ:Rd×Z→R denote the loss. The norm ∥⋅∥ is Euclidean. An unknown probability measure ν on ZK has coordinate marginals ν1,…,νK. Define the group risks and objective by fi(x)=EZ∼νi[ℓ(x,Z)], F(x)=max1≤i≤Kfi(x), and consider the problem minx∈XF(x). The algorithm receives d, K, Z, X, a given point x0, the loss ℓ, and parameters R,G,ε,δ satisfying R≥0,G≥0,0<ε≤1,0<δ≤14. The group laws are accessible through sampling; the gap parameters γ1,…,γK are not algorithm inputs and may enter only the oracle-call budget.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Feasible set and loss). The set X is compact and convex, x0∈X, and ∥x−x0∥≤Rfor every x∈X. The loss ℓ is jointly measurable. For every z∈Z, x,y∈X, and t∈[0,1], 0≤ℓ(x,z)≤1,ℓ((1−t)x+ty,z)≤(1−t)ℓ(x,z)+tℓ(y,z),|ℓ(x,z)−ℓ(y,z)|≤G∥x−y∥.

Assumption 2 (Independent group reservoirs). The coordinate maps on ZK are mutually independent under ν. There is a probability law Q on reservoirs (Zn)n≥0∈(ZK)N such that the row variables Zn are measurable, mutually independent, and each has law ν. Writing Zn=(Zn,1,…,Zn,K), a query to group i returns Zm,i, where m is the number of previous queries to that group. The algorithm’s randomness is independent of the reservoir.

Assumption 3 (Optimum gaps). The parameters satisfy 0≤γi≤1 for every group i. There exists a common point x⋆∈X such that F(x⋆)≤F(x)for every x∈X,γi≤F(x⋆)−fi(x⋆)for i=1,…,K.

Each oracle call selects one group and returns one sample in Z; the budget counts the total number of such calls across all groups. After these calls, the output x¯ must be measurable and belong to X for every realization. Its required accuracy is P(F(x¯)−F(x⋆)>ε)≤δ, where P is the joint law of the algorithm’s randomness and the independent reservoir with law Q.

comparisonHtml:
Compact convex Q⊂Rd, x0∈Q, ∥x−x0∥≤R, R,G≥0; jointly measurable sample losses are convex, G-Lipschitz and [0,1]-valued on Q. Each call returns one fresh sample from a chosen group, with independence across groups and draws; stored samples may be reused. For K≥1, 0<ε≤1, 0<δ≤1/4, the target is Y∈Q with Pr{F(Y)−F(x⋆)>ε}≤δ. At some minimizer x⋆, 0≤gi≤Δi:=F(x⋆)−fi(x⋆). Gaps and x⋆ are not algorithm inputs; the setup imposes no method restriction.

import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.MeasurableSpace
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.ProbabilityMeasure

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

namespace LongTails.Setups.OptimumGapGroupDro

open OracleTemplate

abbrev Space (d : ℕ) := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

structure Public where
  d : ℕ
  K : ℕ
  [nonzeroK : NeZero K]
  Z : Type
  [measurableZ : MeasurableSpace Z]
  domain : Set (Space d)
  x0 : Space d
  loss : Space d → Z → ℝ
  R : ℝ
  G : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  δ : ℝ

attribute [instance] Public.nonzeroK Public.measurableZ

structure Params where
  data : Public
  gaps : Fin data.K → ℝ

abbrev Rows (q : Public) := Fin q.K → q.Z

abbrev Reservoir (q : Public) := ℕ → Rows q

noncomputable def risk (q : Public) (p : ProbabilityMeasure (Rows q))
    (i : Fin q.K) (x : Space q.d) : ℝ :=
  ∫ z, q.loss x (z i) ∂(p : Measure (Rows q))

noncomputable def objective (q : Public) (p : ProbabilityMeasure (Rows q))
    (x : Space q.d) : ℝ :=
  ⨆ i : Fin q.K, risk q p i x

def groupCount (q : Public) (history : List ((Fin 1 × Fin q.K) × q.Z))
    (i : Fin q.K) : ℕ :=
  history.countP (fun entry => decide (entry.1.2 = i))

noncomputable def reservoirOracle (q : Public) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (Reservoir q)) :
    Oracle (Fin q.K) q.Z where
  Seed := fun _ => Reservoir q
  law := P.map (fun ω => fun _ : ℕ => ω)
  answer history query ω := ω (groupCount q history query.2) query.2

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Public
  Instance q := ProbabilityMeasure (Rows q)
  Query q := Fin q.K
  Reply q := q.Z
  Output q := Space q.d
  publicInput p := p.data
  valid p :=
    0 ≤ p.data.R ∧ 0 ≤ p.data.G ∧ 0 < p.data.ε ∧ p.data.ε ≤ 1 ∧
    0 < p.data.δ ∧ p.data.δ ≤ 1 / 4 ∧
    p.data.x0 ∈ p.data.domain ∧ IsCompact p.data.domain ∧
    Convex ℝ p.data.domain ∧
    (∀ x ∈ p.data.domain, ‖x - p.data.x0‖ ≤ p.data.R) ∧
    Measurable (Function.uncurry p.data.loss) ∧
    (∀ z, ConvexOn ℝ p.data.domain (fun x => p.data.loss x z)) ∧
    (∀ z, ∀ x ∈ p.data.domain, 0 ≤ p.data.loss x z ∧ p.data.loss x z ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ z, ∀ x ∈ p.data.domain, ∀ y ∈ p.data.domain,
      |p.data.loss x z - p.data.loss y z| ≤ p.data.G * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∀ i, 0 ≤ p.gaps i ∧ p.gaps i ≤ 1)
  admissible p model O :=
    iIndepFun (fun i (z : Rows p.data) => z i) (model : Measure _) ∧
    (∃ P : ProbabilityMeasure (Reservoir p.data),
      StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun n (ω : Reservoir p.data) => ω n)
        (model : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧ O = reservoirOracle p.data P) ∧
    (∃ xstar ∈ p.data.domain,
      IsMinOn (objective p.data model) p.data.domain xstar ∧
      ∀ i, p.gaps i ≤ objective p.data model xstar - risk p.data model i xstar)
  successful p model output P :=
    Measurable output ∧ (∀ ω, output ω ∈ p.data.domain) ∧
    ∃ xstar ∈ p.data.domain,
      IsMinOn (objective p.data model) p.data.domain xstar ∧
      (P : Measure _) {ω | p.data.ε < objective p.data model (output ω) -
        objective p.data model xstar} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal p.data.δ

end LongTails.Setups.OptimumGapGroupDro
